title: A skill is a folder

title: Structure isn't a fact-check
text: Consistent shape doesn't prove the deal is healthy. The skill structures whatever the documents say, including a bad clause or a stale draft. Structure isn't a check on the underlying facts.

title: Different isn't wrong
text: And two summaries that look different without the skill aren't necessarily wrong. They might both be reasonable readings, just organized differently. That's the exact inconsistency the skill removes. A skill doesn't make Claude

title: Carry-out
text: Better at judgment. It makes Claude follow the same steps in the same order every single time.
